name: AAAS 3830E
title: Environmental History in East Asia
description: (Also offered as HIST 3830E.) Interactions between humans and the natural world in East Asia, with attention to the environmental impact of politics, economics, and culture. Topics include natural resources, energy, ideas about nature, pollution, and environmentalism. Geographical coverage may include one or more of the following: China, Japan, Korea, and Taiwan. CA 4-INT.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
